name: Tanod
description: Tanod offers pay-per-call APIs and an MCP server for AI agents: about 170 x402 routes covering security pre-checks, PDF and document conversion, web-to-Markdown and screenshots, DNS/RDAP, chain reads, OCR and utilities. Paid in USDC on Base and Polygon via the CDP facilitator, with a free daily allowance per IP and no signup.
